capabilities.notes: AbletonOSC README (checked 2026-10-28). Returns major_version, minor_version only - no patch level, so the 12.0.5 check for create_audio_clip needs Help > About Live. User run 2026-10-28: raw=(12, 4).
AbletonOSC README (checked 2026-10-28). Response: tempo_bpm. User run 2026-10-28: raw=(120.0,); also used as the request-bracketing marker (marker_echo PASS).
AbletonOSC README (checked 2026-10-28). Optional params: index_min, index_max (not exercised). User run 2026-10-28: 4 tracks read correctly.
AbletonOSC README (checked 2026-10-28). Params: track_id, mute (1/0). User run 2026-10-28: both directions written and read back via /live/track/get/mute (R1-R3 ok) on a MIDI track of a test set.

AbletonOSC README 'Track API' (checked 2026-10-28): /live/track/get/mute track_id -> track_id, mute; source abletonosc/track.py properties_rw contains 'mute'. Read-back for track.mute.set; until #42 it borrowed that gate. User run 2026-10-28 (script 0.1.0): read R0-R4 on track 1 '2-MIDI', raw=(False,)/(True,) matching each preceding write.

AbletonOSC README (checked 2026-10-28). Covers LOM changes, not file operations. User run 2026-10-28: one undo reverted the last mute write (R4 ok). Only a single undo after a single write was verified; multi-step undo is not. Limitation (user decision, PR #42): script 0.1.0 did not re-read the whole set after undo (bug #39), so an undo that reverted an unrelated action could not be excluded; run was on Live's default 4-track set, R4 = unmuted. #50 run 4 (2026-10-29, live_import 0.2.0, https://github.com/castorsalzmann-ui/AbeltonGod/issues/50#issuecomment-6495458918): one undo right after clip_slot.create_audio_clip removed the clip, read back with the whole track list; after user interaction in Live (run 2) one undo showed no visible change, cause not established. #143 new-track run (2026-10-29 16:39, live_import 0.3.0, https://github.com/castorsalzmann-ui/AbeltonGod/issues/143#issuecomment-6501223162): ONE undo right after song.create_audio_track + clip_slot.create_audio_clip reverted both writes ('song.undo: PASS (one undo reverted track and clip together)'), i.e. two writes may be one undo step; callers must read back after every undo instead of counting undo steps per write.

AbletonOSC README 'Song API' (checked 2026-10-29): '/live/song/create_audio_track | index | | Create a new audio track at the specified index (-1 = end of list)'; source abletonosc/song.py line 24 (method list, no reply). Only index -1 (append) was used. User run 1 on #50 (2026-10-29 10:32, live_import 0.1.0, https://github.com/castorsalzmann-ui/AbeltonGod/issues/50#issuecomment-6493629463): track created and read back (track_names gained '3-Audio', all 8 slots empty); song.undo SKIPPED. #143 new-track run (2026-10-29 16:39:05-16:39:18, live_import 0.3.0, Live 12.4 per API; user reports 12.4.5; Windows 11), result block lines: 'tracks: ['1-MIDI', '2-MIDI', '3-Audio', '4-Audio']', 'target: new audio track 4, slot 0', 'create_audio_track: confirmed', 'create_audio_clip: confirmed', 'undo_clip: read-back differs', 'clip_slot.create_audio_clip: PASS', 'target_track_name_after_import: '5-dense_s1001_v0'', 'song.undo: PASS (one undo reverted track and clip together)', 'error: -'. The new track was read back as an empty audio track at the end of the list before the clip was sent (ClipImporter.run check_track). Undo granularity: ONE song.undo right after create_audio_track + create_audio_clip (sent one after the other by the script, with the track read-back in between; whole run 13 s) reverted track and clip together: after that one undo the track-name read-back equalled the pre-import list, so the script did not send the second undo (a second undo would have reverted an older, unrelated step). Whether Live always merges the two writes into one undo step, and why, is not established (one run). An undo of create_audio_track alone (without a clip after it) was never run. 'Nothing touched in Live' was the plan, not separately confirmed by the user. Verified only appending one track to a 4-track set (2 MIDI, 2 audio) in Session view; not with index >= 0, not in Arrangement.

Not in the AbletonOSC README (only /live/clip_slot/create_clip for empty MIDI clips); sent as /live/clip_slot/create_audio_clip through the AbeltonGod extension (scripts/install_abletonosc_extension.py, pinned to AbletonOSC commit 0ca68214). User runs 2, 3 and 4 on 2026-10-29 (Live 12.4 per API; user reports 12.4.5; Windows 11, live_import 0.2.0, existing audio track 0, slot 0, absolute WAV path): clip_slot.create_audio_clip PASS and clip file_path read back equal to the WAV in all three (run 2: https://github.com/castorsalzmann-ui/AbeltonGod/issues/50#issuecomment-6495315110, runs 3 and 4: #issuecomment-6495458918). Listening: the user heard the kick in run 1 (new track, chat confirmation, #issuecomment-6493153063) and run 2; runs 3 and 4 recorded user_hears_kick: yes, but it is not established whether the clip was launched in run 3 or in run 4 (the run-3 plan was to answer without playing, #issuecomment-6495356008). Live renames a default-named target track after the clip ('1-Audio' -> '1-centre_s1001_v0'). Undo: run 4 (whole run 16 s, 12:29:47-12:30:03) one song.undo removed the clip and restored the track name, read back; it is not established whether the clip was launched (or anything else done in Live) between import and undo in run 4, so run 4 neither supports nor rules out the launch hypothesis. Limitations: undo after user interaction in Live is not reliable - run 2 (39 s between import and undo; the script had asked the user to launch the clip in Live) sent one undo and the read-back showed no change after 3 polls, cause not established; run 3: the set was already back to the pre-import state before the script's undo (most likely the user's own interaction in Live, not confirmed); the pre-check refused and sent nothing (correct, https://github.com/castorsalzmann-ui/AbeltonGod/issues/50#issuecomment-6495491039). Verified only on an existing audio track, Session view, one WAV file; not on a new track with live_import 0.2.0, not in Arrangement, not with other formats.

AbletonOSC README 'Song API' (checked 2026-10-29): '/live/song/get/num_scenes | | num_scenes | Query the number of scenes'; source abletonosc/song.py line 228. Until #143 it borrowed the clip_slot.create_audio_clip gate. Read by live_import before every plan; result block line 'num_scenes: 8' in #50 run 1 (0.1.0, https://github.com/castorsalzmann-ui/AbeltonGod/issues/50#issuecomment-6493110727), run 2 (0.2.0, #issuecomment-6495315110), run 4 (0.2.0, #issuecomment-6495458918), #129 (kick_to_live 0.1.0 / live_import 0.3.0, https://github.com/castorsalzmann-ui/AbeltonGod/issues/129#issuecomment-6500517343) and the #143 new-track run (0.3.0, https://github.com/castorsalzmann-ui/AbeltonGod/issues/143#issuecomment-6501223162). In the same runs has_clip was read for slots 0-7 without an error, consistent with 8 scenes. Limitation: only the value 8 was ever seen (2- and 4-track test sets); a set with another scene count, or 0 scenes, was not read in Live.

AbletonOSC README 'Track API' (checked 2026-10-29): '/live/track/get/has_audio_input | track_id | track_id, has_audio_input | Query has_audio_input'; source abletonosc/track.py line 39 (properties_r). LOM Track.has_audio_input: 1 for audio tracks. Until #143 it borrowed the clip_slot.create_audio_clip gate. live_import 0.2.0/0.3.0 read it for every track before the plan; a malformed reply stops the run with an error. Runs ending 'error: -' with MIDI and audio tracks in the set: #50 run 4 (tracks ['1-Audio', '2-MIDI'], https://github.com/castorsalzmann-ui/AbeltonGod/issues/50#issuecomment-6495458918), #129 and the #143 new-track run (tracks ['1-MIDI', '2-MIDI', '3-Audio', '4-Audio']). Value true is evidenced by the import pre-check, which refuses a track whose reply is false before anything is sent: existing audio tracks '1-Audio' (#50 runs 2-4) and '3-Audio' (#129, 'target: track 2 '3-Audio', slot 0', import PASS); and on the new track in the #143 run, whose read-back requires true before the clip is sent ('create_audio_clip: confirmed'). Limitation: the value false (for the MIDI tracks) was read but is in no pasted output (the script prints it only as the console track list); not read on group, return or master tracks.

AbletonOSC README 'Clip Slot API' (checked 2026-10-29): '/live/clip_slot/get/has_clip | track_index, clip_index | track_index, clip_index, has_clip | Query whether the slot has a clip'; source abletonosc/clip_slot.py line 34. Until #143 it borrowed the clip_slot.create_audio_clip gate. Both values in the user's action-log lines: #50 run 1 (0.1.0, https://github.com/castorsalzmann-ui/AbeltonGod/issues/50#issuecomment-6493629463) 'create_audio_track read_back after: has_clip [0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]' and 'create_audio_clip read_back after: has_clip [1,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]' (the clip was visible in Live, user screenshot #issuecomment-6493126878); #50 run 2 (#issuecomment-6495356008) '"has_clip": [1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]' with the clip still in Live per the user; #50 run 3 refused line (#issuecomment-6495491039) '"now": {"has_clip": [0, 0, ...]' after which the pre-check refused and sent nothing. The undo PASS lines of #50 run 4 and #129 ('song.undo: PASS (clip removed; read back)') rest on this read. Limitation: verified only on audio tracks in Session view with 8 scenes; not on MIDI, group or return tracks.

AbletonOSC README 'Clip API' (checked 2026-10-29): '/live/clip/get/file_path | track_id, clip_id | track_id, clip_id, file_path | Get clip file path'; source abletonosc/clip.py line 74 (properties_r). LOM Clip.file_path: only available for audio clips. Until #143 it borrowed the clip_slot.create_audio_clip gate. Result block line 'clip_file_path_read' equal to the imported WAV in #50 run 2 and run 4 (0.2.0, 'C:\\Users\\phili\\Music\\AbeltonGod-Test\\centre_s1001_v0.wav', https://github.com/castorsalzmann-ui/AbeltonGod/issues/50#issuecomment-6495315110, #issuecomment-6495458918), #129 and the #143 new-track run (0.3.0, '...\\Samples\\Drums\\Kicks\\dense_s1001_v0.wav', https://github.com/castorsalzmann-ui/AbeltonGod/issues/129#issuecomment-6500517343, https://github.com/castorsalzmann-ui/AbeltonGod/issues/143#issuecomment-6501223162); the #143 existing-track run is reported as 'file path read back' in the lead's summary only (no result block pasted, #issuecomment-6501196033). Live returns the path with backslashes (Windows). #50 run 1 ('file_path null') did not request it: script 0.1.0 stopped on the renamed track first (cause established in PR #97). Limitation: read only right after an import, only for audio clips created by clip_slot.create_audio_clip from an absolute WAV path; an empty slot makes AbletonOSC's handler fail (clip.py line 55, AbletonOSCError) - not exercised in Live; not read for clips recorded or dragged in by the user.
No known API route. Use resampling or manual export.
